label: original-phase steps (t=2..6) after a w has been seen
explanation: Fires during the original (input) phase on steps that come after the letter w appeared earlier in the sequence, at absolute positions t=2..6 (never t<2, essentially never t>=7, never in the copy phase; a small tail at the <DEL> step). prev2_tok=w gives 11.7x lift and prev_tok=w 8.8x. Activation peaks 1-2 steps after the w and decays over the next few steps. The largest activations (~7) come from sequences that start w w w: about 0.5 on the third w, then max on the next token, then fading. Several early ws make it stronger. It does not depend on what the current token is. The predicate gets most of the activation mass (dev mass recall 0.95), but precision is only about 0.63: many steps after a w stay silent, especially when the w came late or several steps back. About 4% of the mass is weak firing in sequences with no w at all.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig2=w (+5.63), prev2_tok=w (+5.57), orig1=w (+4.99), prev_tok=w (+4.61), prev3_tok=w (+3.84), orig0=w (+2.74). Lower it: phase=2 (-12.73), prev2_tok=- (-9.24), t=8 (-7.91), orig_idx=-1 (-5.95).
